channel.title: MAG 7 Daily
channel.description:
The seven largest US companies — Alphabet, Amazon, Apple, Meta, Microsoft, NVIDIA and Tesla — as one daily desk. The previous session's closes, the news that moved each company, one story that runs across several of them, and the dates coming up. Facts and numbers, never picks. Not financial advice.
AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.
